text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
“—Alright! Followed you on Umastagram! I'm 
in your followers list, right?”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that one! The one with 68,320 
followers! Wait, what's with that 
terrified face?! Hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I kept followin' back anyone I found 
interesting, and my list blew up! My 
timeline's like a raging torrent, it's 
wild! On the flip side, I never get bored 
of it~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna spam hearts on it! Keep those 
fun posts comin'~☆
